title: Give StagedPrivateSeed a Drop that removes unpublished staging files
description: P3 (wave-3 review of worker6-xyk3): lichend.rs StagedPrivateSeed has no Drop; a caller that stages but never publish()es leaks the 0600 temp seed file. Production path is stage->publish back-to-back (latent), and a post-link failure also returns Err though the seed was published (fail-closed, acceptable). Fix: implement Drop to unlink the staging path if still unpublished, and document the post-link Err-on-sync-failure semantics.
